meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你选择、提交并管理 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验方案,包括准备输入、核对价格与周期、走完订购流程,还能用 EstiMate 获取自定义方案的可行性评估和报价。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上运行蛋白表达与纯化、定量检测或 RNA 合成等实验,或需要提交方案、获取报价等平台操作时。

say.text: 帮我查一下 IVT mRNA 合成方案的价格和周期。
say.note: 返回该方案的价格和周期信息。

say.text: 我想表达并纯化一个蛋白,帮我选个方案。
say.note: Claude 会根据需求推荐表达纯化方案。

say.text: 用 EstiMate 评估我的自定义实验流程,看能不能做。
say.note: 进入 EstiMate 获得可行性与报价。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude helps you pick and submit Cloud Lab protocols: prepare inputs, check price/turnaround, complete ordering. It can also use EstiMate for custom workflow quotes.
howto.when_en: When you want to run protein expression/purification, quantification, or RNA synthesis on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, or otherwise use its services.

say_en.text: Look up the price and turnaround for the IVT mRNA synthesis protocol.
say_en.note: Returns that protocol's price and turnaround.

say_en.text: I want to express and purify a protein; help me choose a protocol.
say_en.note: Claude recommends a suitable expression/purification option.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess my custom workflow and tell me if it's feasible.
say_en.note: Runs EstiMate for feasibility and pricing.
